title: El Cenizo marks 22 years of Thanksgiving community dinner, with nearly 500 expected
excerpt: Webb County Treasurer Raul Reyes is preparing the 22nd Annual Thanksgiving Community Dinner in El Cenizo, a tradition he started 22 years ago. Organizers hope to serve close to 500 people.
content:
Webb County Treasurer Raul Reyes is getting ready for the 22nd Annual Thanksgiving Community Dinner in El Cenizo, a tradition he started more than two decades ago.

Reyes said Monday he had bought the remaining turkeys for the dinner, where organizers hope to serve close to 500 people.

The dinner began 22 years ago, when Reyes was 21 and had just been elected mayor of El Cenizo. He said the meal has always been about more than food — bringing families together, creating memories, and reminding people that no matter their circumstances, they deserve the warmth, dignity, and joy of the holiday season.

Reyes said he grew up with humble beginnings and knows what it is like to struggle and go without, and that giving back has always been part of who he is.

Source: Raul Reyes, Webb County Treasurer, Nov. 23, 2026.
